subsystems.name: Signal delivery lines
subsystems.role: carry microwave control and readout signals from room temperature to the mixing chamber with minimal loss and noise.

subsystems.name: Thermal anchoring
subsystems.role: intercept heat conducted down the cables at each cooling stage so the dilution unit is not overloaded.

subsystems.name: Superconducting flexible circuits
subsystems.role: replace bulky coax bundles with high-density ribbons that carry many signals through narrow apertures.

subsystems.name: Noise isolation
subsystems.role: prevent room-temperature noise and back-action from reaching the qubits.

subsystems.name: Multiplexing and control electronics
subsystems.role: reduce the number of physical lines by sharing control and readout across qubits.

buildSteps.title: Define the signal chain and heat budget
buildSteps.detail: Each line's attenuation, filtering and thermal anchoring are chosen so the total heat load stays within the refrigerator's cooling power at every stage.

buildSteps.title: Select materials and components
buildSteps.detail: Cables are chosen for low thermal conductivity and low loss; attenuators and filters must work at cryogenic temperatures.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate superconducting ribbons
buildSteps.detail: Thin films of niobium or niobium-titanium are deposited on flexible polyimide, patterned into many parallel traces, and terminated with superconducting connectors.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the harness
buildSteps.detail: Coaxial lines, attenuators, filters and circulators are soldered or clamped together into a loom that fits the refrigerator's internal space.

buildSteps.title: Thermally anchor at each stage
buildSteps.detail: The harness is clamped to copper stages at 50 K, 4 K, the still, the cold plate and the mixing chamber, often with a deliberate length of cable to isolate heat.

buildSteps.title: Route and connect
buildSteps.detail: The loom is threaded through the cryostat's narrow ports and connected to the qubit chip and to room-temperature electronics.

buildSteps.title: Test and characterise
buildSteps.detail: Signal loss, noise temperature, crosstalk and heat load are measured; wiring is often the limiting factor on how many qubits can be operated.
